measurementRules: Do not sum repeated copies in app/milestones/diagnostic/performance.
SPUPROF/JITPROF and COREPROF process_window counters are drained every report, even when window is omitted in the printed line; tie to the same preceding FRAMEPROF527 epoch.
JITPROF_BOOT is a separate boot view overlapping the first process report; never add it to interval totals.
The manually measured SPU spu_build includes cache read time; do not add those phase totals as exclusive critical-path work.
JIT and pipeline wall-time sums can overlap across threads and guest work; they are not serial lost wall time or potential FPS gain.

FRAMEPROF527 intervals exclude native UI; COREPROF frames/ring FPS can include initial UI and in-flight boundary work. First windows and stopped windows are excluded from selected gameplay-like phases.
COREPROF avg_fps uses completed interval duration, not total wall-clock window; zero frames after the final completed interval can be hidden in that average.
Guest percentiles are per-window and cannot be averaged to obtain a session percentile; only counts/durations are summed.
NeoSwap fields explicitly scoped process_lifetime are differenced only inside the same PID; samples are not summed.
JITMEM hybrid hash includes worker activity; OPT581 worker bytes/time must not be added to it. Zero hybrid counters on BO2/AC do not prove zero texture validation work.
RSXFRAME551 sampled per-frame costs, COREPROF *_cores summed CPU groups and RSX FIFO busy are different quantities; gpu_time_ms=-1 supplies no GPU execution measurement.
frame_latency measures presentation ordering/guest cadence and can contain the same pipeline/compiler delay; do not add it to shader stalls.
SHADERPIPE543_COSTLY entries are recent retained fingerprints, not independent repeated compiles each report.
Log budget suppressed28 and32 messages in AC startup; retained diagnostic spans begin late and are not complete process error traces.
The selected phase elapsed time is the sum of process_window durations; its first/last report timestamps are reporting endpoints, not the beginning/end of every operation.
spu_cache_read events count scoped cache-load operations, not OS read syscalls. Their byte counter is decoded object bytes, not compressed file size.
During zero-frame windows, no completed guest interval exists: a zero reported percentile/max is not a zero-latency measurement.
